params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Icebreaker:}} Enemies {{tip|stun|stunned}} by {{ci|Sejuani}} are also marked ''Frozen'' at the same time. Her next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against a ''Frozen'' target will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} based on {{as|their '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains ''Frost Armor'', which lingers shortly after taking damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or large {{tip|monsters}}. She restores it after a period without taking damage from them.
params.blurb4: [[File:Sejuani Frost Armor.png|20px|link=]]{{sbc|Frost Armor:}} Sejuani gains {{sti|armor|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}, as well as {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}} and {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - Icebreaker:}} Enemies {{tip|stun|stunned}} by '''Sejuani''' are marked ''Frozen'' for the disable's duration. '''Sejuani's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or {{tip|ability}} against a ''Frozen'' enemy will consume the mark to deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|10% of their '''maximum''' health}}, capped at 250 against epic monsters.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains ''Frost Armor'', which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy {{tip|champions}}, {{tip|turrets}}, or large {{tip|monsters}}. She restores it after {{pp|12 - (12-6)/17*(x-1) for 20}} seconds without taking damage from them.
params.description3: {{sbc|Frost Armor:}} '''Sejuani''' gains {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}, {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}, {{sti|armor|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' armor) '''bonus''' armor}}}}, and {{sti|mr|{{as|10 (+ 75% '''bonus''' magic resistance) '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}.
params.notes:
* Gaining ''Frost Armor'' does not remove any pre-existing {{tip|slow|slows}} or {{tip|cripple|cripples}}.
* ''Icebreaker'' will not trigger if the basic attack is {{tip|blocked}} or misses due to {{tip|blind}}.
* ''Frost Armor's'' bonus {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resist}} are calculated from bonus resistances <u>excluding</u> {{iis|Jak'Sho, The Protean}} {{nie|Voidborn Resilience}} and {{bi|Mountainous Vigor}}. The resulting stats are then scaled {{tip|stacks multiplicatively|multiplicatively}} by the 2 multipliers.
* {{Pending for test}}: ''Icebreaker's '' interactions with {{tip|dodge|dodging}} effects via basic attack.
* {{Pending for test}}: {{tip|Spell shield}} interaction with ''Icebreaker''.

blurb.plain: Innate - Icebreaker: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are also marked Frozen at the same time. Her next basic attack or ability against a Frozen target will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage based on their maximum health.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Frost Armor: Sejuani gains Frost Armor, which lingers shortly after taking damage from enemy champions or large monsters. She restores it after a period without taking damage from them.

blurb4.plain: Frost Armor: Sejuani gains bonus armor and bonus magic resist, as well as slow immunity and cripple immunity.

description.plain: Innate - Icebreaker: Enemies stunned by Sejuani are marked Frozen for the disable's duration. Sejuani's next basic attack or ability against a Frozen enemy will consume the mark to deal bonus magic damage equal to 10% of their maximum health, capped at 250 against epic monsters.

description2.plain: Innate - Frost Armor: Sejuani gains Frost Armor, which lingers for 3 seconds after taking damage from enemy champions, turrets, or large monsters. She restores it after 12 – 5.29 (based on level) seconds without taking damage from them.

description3.plain: Frost Armor: Sejuani gains slow immunity, cripple immunity, 10 (+ 75% bonus armor) bonus armor, and 10 (+ 75% bonus magic resistance) bonus magic resistance.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sejuani}} {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking up}} enemies she passes through. She will stop upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''{{ui|Bristle|nolink=true}}''' {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he collides with an enemy {{tip|champion}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description3: ''Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.''
params.notes:
* ''Arctic Assault'' has no minimum dash range.
* Champions will be slightly {{tip|airborne|knocked back}}, while [[minion]]s and [[monster]]s will instead be slightly {{tip|airborne|pulled}} for a fixed distance. Neither can displace through terrain.
* Casting {{si|Flash}} during ''Arctic Assault'' will end the dash and affect enemies at the new location.
* If the dash collides with an enemy champion, '''Sejuani''' will be ordered to basic attack them.

blurb.plain: Active: Sejuani dashes to the target location, dealing magic damage and briefly knocking up enemies she passes through. She will stop upon hitting an enemy champion.

description.plain: Active: Bristle dashes to the target location until he collides with an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to enemies he passes through and knocking them up for 0.5 seconds.

description3.plain: Arctic Assault can be cast during her other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa.

params.blurb2: She then lashes out the flail in a line in the same direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow|slowing}} enemies hit.

blurb.plain: Active: Sejuani swings her flail in a cone in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit, knocking back minions and monsters.

blurb2.plain: She then lashes out the flail in a line in the same direction, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing enemies hit.

blurb3.plain: Sejuani can move while casting Winter’s Wrath.

description.plain: Active: After 0.25 seconds into the cast time, Sejuani swings her flail in a cone in the target direction that deals physical damage to enemies hit and knocks back minions and monsters hit, though not through terrain.

description2.plain: After the cast time, Sejuani lashes out with her flail in a line in the same direction, dealing physical damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 75% for 0.25 seconds.

description3.plain: Sejuani can move during Winter's Wrath's cast time.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ai|Winter's Wrath|Sejuani}} and both {{cis|Sejuani}} and nearby allied {{tip|melee}} champions' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} apply {{tip|stacks}} of ''Frost'' against {{tip|champions}}, medium / large {{tip|monsters}} and large {{tip|minions}}, which lasts a few seconds and stacks up to a cap. '''Sejuani''' can cast ''Permafrost'' against an enemy with max stacks.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' hurls a trap at the target enemy that consumes their ''Frost'' stacks and {{tip|knockdown|knocks them down}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them.
params.blurb3: Once an enemy's ''Frost'' stacks are consumed, they cannot gain any more for a period.
params.description:
{{sbc|Passive - Frostbrand:}} ''{{ai|Winter's Wrath|Sejuani}}'' and both '''Sejuani's''' and nearby allied {{tip|melee}} champions' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} apply {{tip|stacks}} of ''Frost'' to enemy {{tip|champions}}, medium or large {{tip|monsters}}, and large {{tip|minions}} for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is ''{{ai|Fury of the North|Sejuani|Frozen}}''. Enemies hit by ''Permafrost'' or ''{{ais|Glacial Prison|Sejuani}}'' bola have all of their ''Frost'' stacks consumed. Enemy champions cannot be affected by ''Frost'' for 8 seconds after having it consumed.

'''Sejuani''' can cast ''Permafrost'' against an enemy with 4 stacks.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' hurls a trap at the {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy with 4 stacks of ''Frost'' closest to the cursor, which deals {{as|magic damage}}, {{tt|displaces|Does not apply airborne nor is a knockdown. Applies a move block (forced movement) which can interrupt dashes and other displacements.}} them slightly, and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second.

blurb.plain: Passive: Winter's Wrath and both Sejuani and nearby allied melee champions' basic attacks on-hit apply stacks of Frost against champions, medium / large monsters and large minions, which lasts a few seconds and stacks up to a cap. Sejuani can cast Permafrost against an enemy with max stacks.

blurb2.plain: Active: Sejuani hurls a trap at the target enemy that consumes their Frost stacks and knocks them down, dealing magic damage and briefly stunning them.

blurb3.plain: Once an enemy's Frost stacks are consumed, they cannot gain any more for a period.

description.plain: Passive - Frostbrand: Winter's Wrath and both Sejuani's and nearby allied melee champions' basic attacks on-hit apply stacks of Frost to enemy champions, medium or large monsters, and large minions for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 4 times, though not applying if the target is Frozen. Enemies hit by Permafrost or Glacial Prison bola have all of their Frost stacks consumed. Enemy champions cannot be affected by Frost for 8 seconds after having it consumed. Sejuani can cast Permafrost against an enemy with 4 stacks.

description2.plain: Active: Sejuani hurls a trap at the visible enemy with 4 stacks of Frost closest to the cursor, which deals magic damage, displaces them slightly, and stuns them for 1 second.

description3.plain: Permafrost resets Sejuani's basic attack timer.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Sejuani}} throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them.
params.blurb2: If the bola travels far enough, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching max range or hitting an enemy champion, gaining increased damage and stun duration. The detonation creates a frost storm that {{tip|slows}} enemies within and shatters after a few seconds, dealing the increased damage to all enemies within.
params.blurb3: After a brief moment, the storm shatters to deal {{as|magic damage}} and briefly {{tip|slow}} enemies within.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sejuani''' throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for 1 second.
params.description2: If the bola travels at least 425 units, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching maximum range or hitting an enemy champion, dealing increased {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds instead. For the same duration, a frost storm is created around the location of the detonation that {{tip|slows}} enemies within by 30% and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area in a smaller radius.
params.description3: After 2 seconds, the storm shatters to deal the increased {{as|magic damage}} to enemies within and {{tip|slow}} them by 80% for 1 second, as well as {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them and granting {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|0.5}} seconds.
params.description4: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|450|Storm damage radius}}|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|450|Storm slow radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|300|Storm sight radius}}}}
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} to the primary target and {{tip|area damage}} to secondary targets in the ice storm.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shields}} will block only a single instance of damage.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* Both areas of effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
params.tips: * {{ai|Q|Sejuani}} can be used after casting ''Glacial Prison'' to hide the cast animation.

blurb.plain: Active: Sejuani throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage and briefly stunning them.

blurb2.plain: If the bola travels far enough, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching max range or hitting an enemy champion, gaining increased damage and stun duration. The detonation creates a frost storm that slows enemies within and shatters after a few seconds, dealing the increased damage to all enemies within.

blurb3.plain: After a brief moment, the storm shatters to deal magic damage and briefly slow enemies within.

description.plain: Active: Sejuani throws an ice bola in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage and stunning them for 1 second.

description2.plain: If the bola travels at least 425 units, it becomes empowered to detonate upon reaching maximum range or hitting an enemy champion, dealing increased magic damage and stunning for 1.5 seconds instead. For the same duration, a frost storm is created around the location of the detonation that slows enemies within by 30% and grants sight of the area in a smaller radius.

description3.plain: After 2 seconds, the storm shatters to deal the increased magic damage to enemies within and slow them by 80% for 1 second, as well as revealing them and granting sight of the area for 0.5 seconds.

description4.plain: The enemy hit by the bola is unaffected by the storm's effects.
